listing.tagline: Ask Claude what the memory analysis found
listing.description: A skill that lets Claude read the Memory Diagnoser's saved analysis of your CLAUDE.md files, rules and auto memory. Run /memory-diagnoser:memory-analysis with a question, such as "what did the analysis find here?". Claude answers with the health score and each finding: its files, the evidence and a suggested fix. You start an analysis in the Memory Diagnoser.
